findings.evidence: Both transport lemmas are iffs: `Cyclotomic/Frobenius.lean:182` `isArithFrobAt_iff_galEquivZMod_eq_absNorm … : IsArithFrobAt (𝓞 F) σ Q ↔ …`, `Ideal/IntegersRat.lean:121` `isArithFrobAt_ringOfIntegers_rat_iff … : IsArithFrobAt (𝓞 ℚ) σ Q ↔ IsArithFrobAt ℤ σ Q`, and `Units.val_inj` (mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Units/Defs.lean:122). The proof here uses only `.mp` of each. The repo already consumes the `.mpr` direction of the `absNorm` version: `Chebotarev/FixedField/SeventhCyclotomic.lean:69` `apply (… isArithFrobAt_iff_galEquivZMod_eq_absNorm 𝔭 hm Q _).2`.
findings.fix: State `isArithFrobAt_iff_galEquivZMod_eq_unitOfCoprime (hp : p.Coprime n) (σ : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) : IsArithFrobAt ℤ σ Q ↔ Rat.galEquivZMod n K σ = ZMod.unitOfCoprime p hp`, proved by `rw [← isArithFrobAt_ringOfIntegers_rat_iff, isArithFrobAt_iff_galEquivZMod_eq_absNorm v hn Q σ, hnorm, ← ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime, Units.val_inj]`; derive `galEquivZMod_arithFrobAt` from `.mp`.
findings.issue: `galEquivZMod_eq_unitOfCoprime_of_isArithFrobAt` is one-directional, but every ingredient is an iff under exactly these hypotheses, so the characterization is free. The dropped direction is the useful one for identifying a Frobenius from its exponent (and for uniqueness at `Q`).

findings.evidence: Lines 41-43, 49-51, 58-60 all run `have h := galEquivZMod_eq_unitOfCoprime_of_isArithFrobAt …; exact (congrArg Units.val h).trans (by decide)`. Unit-level residues are the established idiom for `galEquivZMod` consumers: `Cyclotomic/Subfields.lean:44` `(galEquivZMod 5 K).symm (-1 : (ZMod 5)ˣ)` and `Cyclotomic/SeventhCyclotomic/Basic.lean:40` `(Rat.galEquivZMod 7 L).symm (Units.mk0 (3 : ZMod 7) (by decide))`.
findings.fix: State all three as unit equations, e.g. `Rat.galEquivZMod 5 K σ = Units.mk0 (2 : ZMod 5) (by decide)` (resp. `3`, `2`), matching the `-1` form at line 64; drop the `congrArg Units.val` step and close with `Units.ext (by decide)`.
findings.issue: The 2, 3 and 7 cases (lines 40, 48, 56) are stated at the coercion level `(Rat.galEquivZMod 5 K σ : ZMod 5) = k`, weaker in form than the unit equation the general lemma already gives; the proofs discard it with `congrArg Units.val`. The 19 case (line 64) keeps the unit level, so the file is inconsistent and a consumer working in `(ZMod 5)ˣ` must re-apply `Units.val_inj`.

summary: The main theorem is stated as a one-way implication although every step of its proof is an iff with identical hypotheses, so the reverse ("this automorphism is the Frobenius") direction is lost for free; the fifth-cyclotomic instances at 2, 3, 7 are stated at the coercion level, weaker than the unit-level equation the general lemma supplies.
